semantic_description: Provider-neutral contract for compiling bounded project context and executing an authorized engineering plan through implementation, testing, review, verification, and close-out.
responsibilities: Treat project snapshots as provenance-aware derived context and never as authority.
Require independently resolvable authorization for state-changing work.
Represent bounded execution scope and protected-boundary escalation.
Guide owners through unresolved decisions without inventing policy.
Permit uninterrupted in-scope execution after plan authorization.
Preserve evidence, uncertainty, lifecycle, execution, and verification lineage.
non_responsibilities: Granting application, production, or external-system authority.
Loading or starting a harness, skill, plugin, or MCP implementation.
Defining Codex, Claude, DSH, or other provider-specific interfaces.

informative.summary: A harness-neutral execution capability projected into agent clients by adapters.
informative.rationale: Keep reusable execution semantics in Core while allowing each harness to choose its own skill format, invocation, and transport.

metadata.adapter_rule: Harness adapters may project the contract but may not redefine its semantics.
